## Summary
Reviewed head e17a1b01. The final collision pass in `modelChoices` now restarts from each row's original base label, so a shared pinned descriptor is replaced by the full target instead of being stacked with it. Issue 8595 acceptance is met: distinct choices, original ids and full ids kept, cross-family regression through `modelChoices`, one discriminator.

## Strengths
- Minimal, local fix; return type and public signature of `modelChoices` are unchanged, so the app SettingsBar, dashboard ModelPickerModal and SettingsPanel callers and the internal use in `formatActiveModelLabel` are unaffected (they consume `.label/.id/.fullId` only). `tsc --noEmit` and the model-display suite pass for me (21 tests).
- Uniqueness holds by construction: rows are deduplicated by target first, so fallback labels `base (target)` are distinct from each other. I fuzzed 200k random rosters (2-5 rows, mixed bases, aliases, dated pins, `[1m]`, adversarial targets such as `pinned 1.0`): zero duplicate labels and zero repeated `(pinned ..) (..)` shapes. The same fuzz against the pre-fix expression produced the repeated-descriptor shape in about 38% of cases, so the fix is the discriminating change.
- Mixed and 3-way cases behave correctly: alpha-1-0 / beta-1-0 / gamma-1-0 / alpha-2-0 all labelled `Custom` gives `Custom (claude-alpha-1-0)`, `(claude-beta-1-0)`, `(claude-gamma-1-0)`, `Custom (pinned 2.0)`. Only the colliding rows fall back to the full target; the row the descriptor already disambiguates keeps it.
- The control test (descriptor alone disambiguates) guards against over-correcting; the main test asserts exact labels, ids, full ids, no mutation of input rows.

## Critical
None.

## Suggestions
- Commit message lacks the `Trial-Closes: 8595` line (only the PR body has it). If the trial rule applies to commit messages as well, amend before merge; if the squash message is taken from the PR body, nothing to do.
- Optional hardening (defer): a roster could still in theory produce a fallback label equal to an untouched row's label only if a base label itself contains parentheses; this predates the PR and is not reachable from real rosters.

## Nitpicks
- The 3-way and mixed (some rows keep descriptor, some fall back) cases are verified by my fuzz but not by a committed test; a one-line extra case would lock the behavior in. Cheap to fold, not required.

## Verdict
Approve
